role_key.V: Government entity of a country other than gov

definitions.unit: One article record and its primary selected action, not a count of unique real-world events.
definitions.eligible: Government and action identified; align, rep and frame each -1, 0 or +1. Zeros retained.
definitions.P: 4 × positive share × negative share, with all common-eligible articles as denominator.
definitions.domestic: Recorded publication_country equals evaluated government SEN.
definitions.non_domestic: Recorded publication country differs from SEN, including ALL/unknown provenance.
definitions.role: Institutional role, not evidence of direct affiliation with the incumbent.
definitions.other_act: Residual primary-action category; retained in denominators but omitted from specified-action rankings.
definitions.target_null: No coded entity target. This does not establish that an action is unrelated to the evaluated government.

limits: Descriptive model labels, not observed public opinion or causal effects.
Source, event, genre and available-record composition may vary by month.
Publication-country metadata is not proof of an outlet’s nationality, ownership or audience.
The compact caches contain no article text, actor names or identifiers.
Zero includes mixed or insufficient directional evidence; not all zeros imply neutral language.
